clause_text: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be severed and the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

description: Confidentiality and Dispute Governing Clause (Medium Risk)
clause_text: Each party shall hold all confidential information in strict trust. Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in accordance with the governing law.

description: Unlimited Indemnity and Consequential Damages Clause (High Risk)
clause_text: The Vendor shall unconditionally indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client against all liability, damages, breach of contract, negligence, penalties, and default without any monetary limitation.
